about: English's grammar, taught as data (core/semantics/grammar.py reads it): each grammar word's ways of being read (its category: what it combines with and what it makes; its meaning: what its part of the sentence holds), the categories of each kind of word, and the link each place makes where nothing taught says otherwise. A category's term after a dot: a lowercase letter is a variable of the word's meaning, @ the word's own name, ?speaker a term of the situation; an uppercase feature (S[F]) agrees. A meaning's pieces are spelled out in the meaning language by grammar.spell_out.
